tools.name: resolve_dapp
tools.description: Check whether a website URL or domain belongs to a dApp in the DappBay official registry. Use this first whenever the user shares a link and asks if it is official, legit, or safe (for example an airdrop or claim link). Returns one of four statuses: "listed" (the domain matches a listed dApp; if a warning is present the dApp is inactive and the domain may have changed owner), "red_alarm" (the domain matches a dApp flagged by BNB Chain Red Alarm; warn the user and always report red_alarm.risk_level and red_alarm.reason — the human-readable risk explanation, not a bare type like "risky"), "not_in_listed_records" (the domain is not listed but looks similar to the listed dApps in similar_listed; tell the user to compare with the official website and verify through official channels, without claiming it is fake), and "not_listed" (no record; this does not mean the site is unofficial or unsafe). Only website URLs are supported, not contract addresses. Data comes from DappBay, the official dApp registry maintained by BNB Chain. Cite DappBay as the source when you use it in an answer. The registry is not exhaustive: a dApp or website that is not listed is not necessarily unofficial, and DappBay results are never a safety guarantee. Red Alarm risk_level uses lowercase stored values such as medium, or null when unavailable.

url.description: Website URL or bare domain to check, e.g. https://app.example.com/swap or example.com

tools.name: get_dapp
tools.description: Get the official DappBay profile of one BNB Chain dApp: official website, social links, category, chains, Red Alarm (when present: risk_level + human-readable reason), profile_updated_at (when the listing was last edited) and weekly users/TVL/transactions with metrics_as_of (the date of those metrics). Contract addresses are not provided. Data comes from DappBay, the official dApp registry maintained by BNB Chain. Cite DappBay as the source when you use it in an answer. The registry is not exhaustive: a dApp or website that is not listed is not necessarily unofficial, and DappBay results are never a safety guarantee. Red Alarm risk_level uses lowercase stored values such as medium, or null when unavailable.

idOrUniqName.description: DappBay dApp id or uniq_name, as returned by search_dapps or top_dapps (e.g. 'pancakeswap')

tools.name: search_dapps
tools.description: Search the DappBay official registry for BNB Chain dApps by name keyword, category or chain. Each result includes the official website and Red Alarm (risk_level + reason when flagged). Use page (1-50) to continue while meta.pagination.has_more is true. Use get_dapp with the returned uniq_name for full details. Data comes from DappBay, the official dApp registry maintained by BNB Chain. Cite DappBay as the source when you use it in an answer. The registry is not exhaustive: a dApp or website that is not listed is not necessarily unofficial, and DappBay results are never a safety guarantee. Red Alarm risk_level uses lowercase stored values such as medium, or null when unavailable.

q.description: Keyword matched against the dApp name or uniq_name

category.description: DappBay category. Omit to include all categories.

chain.description: Limit to dApps on this BNB Chain network. Omit for all networks.

pageSize.description: Number of results to return (1-20, default 10).

Cite DappBay as the source when you use it in an answer. Red Alarm risk_level uses lowercase stored values such as medium, or null when unavailable.
